description: Preferred way to inject AI-generated or custom visuals into WordFlux: persist a Base64/Data URI image or PDF, vector/SVG graphic (svgMarkup rasterized to PNG), ChatGPT uploaded/generated file (openaiFileIdRefs), or external HTTPS image/PDF URL (imageUrl/pdfUrl) into WordFlux Cloudflare R2 storage for reuse across campaigns. Uploading a PDF returns documentUrl for native LinkedIn PDF carousels.

base64Data.description: Base64 or Data URI image or PDF (data:image/png;base64,... or data:application/pdf;base64,...)

caption.description: Optional caption or description for the Media Library

openaiFileIdRefs.description: Array of user-uploaded or AI-generated image or PDF files from ChatGPT to save into WordFlux R2 storage

pdfUrl.description: Optional HTTPS PDF URL to save permanently to WordFlux R2 for LinkedIn PDF carousels

svgMarkup.description: SVG XML markup or data:image/svg+xml Data URI (e.g. from Claude Artifacts) to rasterize into a crisp PNG

name: wordflux_upload_media
